description.en: Read it in the Xingtai table. This is a grid-powered building pour through a pipeline. Taken from the printed row: The aggregate-13 cell is the short line: 20 m horizontal / 60 m vertical. Keep this cell as published. Maximum aggregate on the page is ≤ 3 cm. Read it in the Xingtai table. Do not move the same condition onto Electric 20, which prints 22 kW, 8–10 m³/h, 10 MPa, 120 m horizontal / 40 m vertical, pipe 80 mm, aggregate 1–2 cm, hopper 0.25 m³, 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm and 900 kg. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. This page names no project, no country job, no price and no daily volume.
description.zh: 这是有电网、走管道的建筑浇筑。13 骨料格是短管路：水平 20 m / 垂直 60 m。这一页的最大骨料是 ≤ 3 cm。邢台河北品锦机械把电动30列为30 kW、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m、最大骨料 ≤ 3 cm、料斗 0.3 m³、外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm、1200 kg。不要把同一工况挪到电动20，那一行印的是22 kW、8–10 m³/h、10 MPa、水平 120 m / 垂直 40 m、管内径 80 mm、骨料 1–2 cm、料斗 0.25 m³、外形 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm、900 kg。本页配图下载自文中的来源页，只作参照。它不是品锦的合同记录。本页不写项目名称、国家工程、价格或日方量。
